Been here for my second 10 day Course in October 2023, The center is between mountains with Great view and it has all the necessary facilities one can ask for.

Rooms : The rooms are quite warm, and even during early winter you do not need extra blankets or sweaters, I was provided a separate room with attached toilet. There is an instant solar water heater within the Facility for hot water.

Drinking water: There is no shortage for drinking water and also all the residential quarters will have water dispensers with hot water facility and also there is hot water / hot ginger water / hot lime water provided in the mess.

Meditation Hall : The meditation halls are quite warm and you would not experience extreme cold and you are provided with enough blankets, Cushions in case you need them.

Meditation Cells : The meditation cells / Pagoda are currently under construction so for now the students will not be allotted any meditation cells and need to meditate in the Meditation hall with everyone.

There would be some care needed in few aspects as its not just cold but also a dry region, but the management and Dhamma Sevaks will guide you on it and will support you to their best.

Great centre, facilities and the team that goes above and beyond. Very grateful for having done my Vipassana here.

Please note it is advised to get to the region at least two days before the course, but I would suggest at least five days if you can in order to get properly acclimatised for a more comfortable experience during the course as well as to explore this unique region.

Perfect place to dive deeper into yourself. Lot of open space, silence and very well managed facility to ensure you have the right set-up to explore your inner self.
